# Solving for market demand in the monopoly setting t=-1
```{r}
# Data values
Qos <- 694444
Pos <- 300
MCQo <- 6.5

# We want to solve the equations
# 1) Pos = a - b*Qos
# 2) MCQo = a - 2*b*Qos        since MCQos=MRQos

A <- matrix(c(1, -Qos,
              1, -2*Qos), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
B <- c(Pos, MCQo)

# Solve for a and b
sol <- solve(A, B)
a <- sol[1]
b <- sol[2]

# Display results
cat("a =", a, "\n")
cat("b =", b, "\n")
```


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)   # for comma formatting

# Data values
Qos <- 694444
Pos <- 300
MCQo <- 6.5

# Solve for demand parameters
A <- matrix(c(1, -Qos,
              1, -2*Qos), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
B <- c(Pos, MCQo)
sol <- solve(A, B)
a <- sol[1]
b <- sol[2]

# Define functions
demand <- function(Q) a - b*Q
MR     <- function(Q) a - 2*b*Q
MC     <- function(Q) MCQo  # constant MC

# Range of quantities
Q <- seq(0, Qos*1.2, length.out = 200)

# Data frame for plotting
df <- tibble(
  Q = Q,
  Demand = demand(Q),
  MR = MR(Q),
  MC = MC(Q)
)

# Equilibrium point
eq_point <- tibble(Q = Qos, P = Pos)

Plot1 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Q)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Demand, color = "Demand"), size = 1.2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = MR, color = "Marginal Revenue"), size = 1.2, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(aes(y = MC, color = "Marginal Cost"), size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(data = eq_point, aes(x = Q, y = P), size = 3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = Qos, linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = Pos, linetype = "dotted") +
  annotate("text", x = Qos, y = 0, label = "Q* = 694,444", vjust = 1.5, size = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Demand" = "darkblue", 
                                "Marginal Revenue" = "red", 
                                "Marginal Cost" = "darkgreen")) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma, expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = c(0,0)) +
  labs(x = "Monthly Quantity of Brand Ozempic (Q)", y = "Price / Cost (CAD)", color = "",
       title = "Novo Nordisk Monopoly Equilibrium") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9))

ggsave("monopoly_equilibrium.png", plot = Plot1,
       width = 8, height = 6, units = "in",
       dpi = 300)   # 300 dpi = print quality
```




# Solving for new equilibrium under the generic paradox 
```{r}
eps1 <- (-1/b)*(Pos/Qos)
eps2 <- -0.9
alpha <- 0.54
g <- 0
years <- 1
b_2 <- (-1/eps2)*(Pos/((1-alpha)*Qos*(1+g)^years))

a_2 <- Pos+b_2*((1-alpha)*Qos*(1+g)^years)

a_2
b_2
```

```{r}
# Solve for the new equilibrium quantity where MR_2Qo = MCQo
Qos_2 <- (a_2 - MCQo) / (2 * b_2)

# Now find the new equilibrium price from the new demand curve
P_2os <- a_2 - b_2 * Qos_2

# Display results
cat("New equilibrium quantity (Qo_2) =", Qos_2, "\n")
cat("New equilibrium price (P_2) =", P_2os, "\n")

```


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)

# --- Original scenario ---
Qos <- 694444
Pos <- 300
MCQo <- 6.5

# Solve for original demand parameters
A <- matrix(c(1, -Qos,
              1, -2*Qos), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
B <- c(Pos, MCQo)
sol <- solve(A, B)
a <- sol[1]; b <- sol[2]

# Original demand and MR
demand1 <- function(Q) a - b*Q
MR1     <- function(Q) a - 2*b*Q

# --- New scenario ---
eps1 <- (-1/b)*(Pos/Qos)
eps2 <- -0.80
alpha <- 0.1
g <- 0; years <- 1

b_2 <- (-1/eps2)*(Pos/((1-alpha)*Qos*(1+g)^years))
a_2 <- Pos + b_2*((1-alpha)*Qos*(1+g)^years)

demand2 <- function(Q) a_2 - b_2*Q
MR2     <- function(Q) a_2 - 2*b_2*Q

# Equilibria
Qos_1 <- Qos; P_1 <- Pos
Qos_2 <- (a_2 - MCQo) / (2*b_2)
P_2   <- a_2 - b_2*Qos_2

# --- Data for plotting ---
Q <- seq(0, max(Qos_1, Qos_2)*1.2, length.out = 300)

df <- tibble(
  Q = Q,
  Demand1 = demand1(Q),
  MR1 = MR1(Q),
  Demand2 = demand2(Q),
  MR2 = MR2(Q),
  MC = MCQo
)

eq_points <- tibble(
  Q = c(Qos_1, Qos_2),
  P = c(P_1, P_2),
  Scenario = c("Old", "New")
)

# --- Plot ---
Plot2 <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Q)) +
  # Old curves (faded blue)
  geom_line(aes(y = Demand1), color = "blue", size = 1, alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(aes(y = MR1), color = "blue", size = 1, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.4) +
  
  # New curves (highlighted red)
  geom_line(aes(y = Demand2), color = "red", size = 1.2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = MR2), color = "red", size = 1.2, linetype = "dashed") +
  
  # Marginal cost
  geom_line(aes(y = MC), color = "darkgreen", size = 1.2) +
  
  # Equilibrium points
  geom_point(data = eq_points, aes(x = Q, y = P, color = Scenario), size = 3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = Qos_1, linetype = "dotted", color = "blue", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = P_1, linetype = "dotted", color = "blue", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = Qos_2, linetype = "dotted", color = "red") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = P_2, linetype = "dotted", color = "red") +
  
  # Regular numeric axes with commas
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma, expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = c(0,0)) +
  
  labs(x = "Monthly Quantity of Brand Ozempic (Q)", y = "Price / Cost (CAD)",
       title = "Novo Nordisk Monopoly Equilibrium: Before and After Entry") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Old" = "blue", "New" = "red")) +
  guides(color = "none")

ggsave("generics_paradox.png", plot = Plot2,
       width = 8, height = 6, units = "in",
       dpi = 600)   # 300 dpi = print quality

```





## Solving the competitive fringe model
```{r}
# ----------------------------
# Fully Algebraic Competitive Fringe Model (with 2 decimals)
# ----------------------------

# Parameters
ff <- 6.5
vv <- 0.001
n <- 8
g2 <- 0.1
years2 <- 8
MCQo <- 6.5

# Po(QNN) formula derived algebraically
Po_QNN <- function(QNN) {
  numerator   <- a*(1 + g2)^years2 / b + n*ff / vv - QNN
  denominator <- 1/b + n/vv
  numerator / denominator
}

# Extract linear form for MR: Po(QNN) = m - k * QNN
m <- (a*(1 + g2)^years2 / b + n*ff / vv) / (1/b + n/vv)
k <- 1 / (1/b + n/vv)

# Solve MR = MCQo algebraically
QNNs <- (m - MCQo) / (2 * k)

# Solve for equilibrium price Pos_2
Pos_2 <- Po_QNN(QNNs)

# ----------------------------
# Fringe production
# Total fringe supply at equilibrium price
Sf_total <- n * ((Pos_2 - ff) / vv)

# Output per-firm production
Sf_per_firm <- Sf_total / n

# Total market supply (dominant firm + fringe)
Q_total <- QNNs + Sf_total

# ----------------------------
# Display results with 2 decimal places
cat("Equilibrium quantity QNNs (dominant firm) =", round(QNNs, 2), "\n")
cat("Equilibrium price Pos_2 =", round(Pos_2, 2), "\n")
cat("Total fringe production Sf_total =", round(Sf_total, 2), "\n")
cat("Per-firm fringe production Sf_per_firm =", round(Sf_per_firm, 2), "\n")
cat("Total market quantity Q_total =", round(Q_total, 2), "\n")

```



```{r}
# ----------------------------
# Competitive Fringe vs Dominant Firm Visualization (with individual generic MC)
# ----------------------------
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)

# --- Parameters ---
ff <- 6.5
vv <- 0.001
n <- 8
g2 <- 0.1
years2 <- 8
MCQo <- 6.5

# Demand parameters from original scenario
Qos <- 694444
Pos <- 300
A <- matrix(c(1, -Qos,
              1, -2*Qos), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
B <- c(Pos, MCQo)
sol <- solve(A, B)
a <- sol[1]; b <- sol[2]

# --- Demand functions ---
Demand_full <- function(Q) a*(1+g2)^years2 - b*Q
m <- (a*(1+g2)^years2 / b + n*ff / vv) / (1/b + n/vv)
k <- 1 / (1/b + n/vv)
Demand_resid <- function(Q) m - k*Q
MR_resid     <- function(Q) m - 2*k*Q

# --- Equilibrium ---
Q_dom <- (m - MCQo) / (2*k)
P_eq  <- Demand_resid(Q_dom)
Q_fringe <- n * ((P_eq - ff) / vv)

# --- Data for plotting ---
Q_seq <- seq(0, 2500000, length.out = 400)
P_seq <- seq(0, max(Pos, P_eq*1.5), length.out = 400)

# Left panel data
df_left_demand <- tibble(Q = Q_seq, P = Demand_full(Q_seq))
df_left_supply <- tibble(Q = n*((P_seq - ff)/vv), P = P_seq)
df_left_MC_ind <- tibble(q = seq(0, max(Q_fringe/n)*1.5, length.out = 200),
                         P = ff + vv*seq(0, max(Q_fringe/n)*1.5, length.out = 200))

# Right panel data
df_right <- tibble(
  Q = Q_seq,
  Demand_full = Demand_full(Q_seq),
  Demand_resid = Demand_resid(Q_seq),
  MR = MR_resid(Q_seq),
  MC = MCQo
)

# --- Shared y-axis limits ---
P_max <- max(df_left_demand$P, df_right$Demand_full, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05

# --- Plots ---
plot_left <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = df_left_demand, aes(x = Q, y = P), color = "lightsalmon", size = 1.2) +
  geom_line(data = df_left_supply, aes(x = Q, y = P), color = "blue", size = 1.2) +
  geom_line(data = df_left_MC_ind, aes(x = q, y = P), color = "blue", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = P_eq, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey40") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = Q_fringe, linetype = "dotted", color = "blue") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma, expand = c(0,0), limits = c(0, 2500000),
                     breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, expand = c(0,0), limits = c(0, P_max),
                     breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
  labs(x = "Quantity of Generics (Qg)", y = "Market Price (CAD)",
       title = "Generic Drugs (Competitive Fringe)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  )

plot_right <- ggplot(df_right, aes(x = Q)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Demand_full), color = "lightsalmon", size = 1.2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Demand_resid), color = "red", size = 1.2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = MR), color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = MC), color = "darkgreen", size = 1.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = Q_dom, linetype = "dotted", color = "red") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = P_eq, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey40") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma, expand = c(0,0), limits = c(0, 2500000),
                     breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, expand = c(0,0), limits = c(0, P_max),
                     breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
  labs(x = "Quantity of Brand Ozempic (Qo)", y = "Market Price (CAD)",
       title = "Novo Nordisk (Dominant Firm)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  )

# Combine side by side
Com_Fringe <- plot_left + plot_right

ggsave("fringe_vs_dominant.png",
       plot = Com_Fringe,
       width = 16,   # increase this for more horizontal space
       height = 6,   # adjust height as needed
       dpi = 300)    # good resolution for print
```








## Generics Paradox Scenario Analysis 
```{r}
# --- Inputs from your earlier blocks ---
Qos  <- 694444
Pos  <- 300
MCQo <- 6.5

# Recover original a, b from your system
A <- matrix(c(1, -Qos,
              1, -2*Qos), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
B <- c(Pos, MCQo)
sol <- solve(A, B)
a <- sol[1]; b <- sol[2]

# Grids
eps2_grid  <- seq(-1.00, -0.75, by = 0.01)       # -1.00, -0.95, ... , -0.75
alpha_grid <- c(0.10, 0.20, 0.30, 0.40, 0.50, 0.60, 0.70)
years_grid <- c(1, 2)
g_grid     <- c(0.00, 0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20)

# Helper: build shifted market size and new demand, then solve monopoly
solve_generic_paradox <- function(Pos, Qos, MCQo, eps2, alpha, years, g) {
  Qshift <- (1 - alpha) * Qos * (1 + g)^years
  # Guardrails
  if (Qshift <= 0) return(data.frame(ok = FALSE))

  b2 <- (-1/eps2) * (Pos / Qshift)
  a2 <- Pos + b2 * Qshift

  # Monopoly equilibrium under new demand
  Q_star <- (a2 - MCQo) / (2 * b2)
  P_star <- a2 - b2 * Q_star

  # Implied elasticity at (P_star, Q_star) for sanity check
  eps_check <- (-1/b2) * (P_star / Q_star)

  data.frame(
    ok = TRUE,
    eps2_target = eps2,
    alpha = alpha,
    years = years,
    g = g,
    Qshift = Qshift,
    a2 = a2,
    b2 = b2,
    Q_star = Q_star,
    P_star = P_star,
    eps_implied = eps_check
  )
}

# Build the full scenario grid
scenarios <- expand.grid(
  eps2 = eps2_grid,
  alpha = alpha_grid,
  years = years_grid,
  g = g_grid,
  KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Evaluate all scenarios
library(dplyr)

results <- scenarios %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  do({
    with(., solve_generic_paradox(Pos, Qos, MCQo, eps2, alpha, years, g))
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(ok) %>%
  mutate(
    # Basic validity checks
    valid_price = P_star > 0,
    valid_quantity = Q_star > 0,
    # Compare implied elasticity to target (at the monopoly point)
    eps_diff = eps_implied - eps2_target
  )

# Quick overview
dplyr::glimpse(results)



summary_tbl <- results %>%
  group_by(eps2_target, alpha, years, g) %>%
  summarise(
    Q_star = Q_star,
    P_star = P_star,
    a2 = a2,
    b2 = b2,
    eps_implied = eps_implied,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(head(summary_tbl, 1000))
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)

# --- Base case ---
base_case <- data.frame(
  eps2_target = -1.021904,
  alpha = 0,
  Q_star = 694444,
  P_star = 300,
  case = "Base Case"
)

# Add label for scenario data
scenario_data <- results %>%
  mutate(case = "Scenario")

# Combine
plot_data <- bind_rows(scenario_data, base_case)

# Explicit alpha order: 0 first, then ascending
alpha_levels <- c(0, sort(unique(plot_data$alpha[plot_data$alpha != 0])))
plot_data$alpha <- factor(plot_data$alpha, levels = alpha_levels, ordered = TRUE)

# Build bar-layer data: scenarios + a dedicated base bar at alpha = 0
bar_data <- plot_data %>% filter(case == "Scenario")
base_bar <- base_case %>%
  mutate(eps2_target = "Base",  # label for fill legend
         alpha = factor(0, levels = alpha_levels),
         case = "Base Bar")

# -----------------------------
# 1. Price vs Elasticity (line graph, red lines)
# -----------------------------
Plot3 <- ggplot(plot_data %>% filter(case == "Scenario"),
       aes(x = eps2_target, y = P_star, group = alpha)) +
  geom_line(color = "red", size = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "red") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 300, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_point(data = base_case, aes(x = eps2_target, y = P_star),
             color = "blue", size = 3, shape = 17, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(290, 360, by = 5),   # tick marks every 5 units
    limits = c(290, 360)              # adjust as needed for your data range
  ) +
  labs(title = "Novo Nordisk Equilibrium Price vs. Assumed Elasticity",
       x = "Elasticity of Remaining Loyal Customers",
       y = "Brand Ozempic Price After Generic Entry (CAD)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

# -----------------------------
# 2. Quantity vs Alpha and Elasticity (grouped bar chart, mature colours)
# -----------------------------
Plot4 <- ggplot(NULL) +
  # Scenario bars
  geom_col(data = bar_data,
           aes(x = alpha, y = Q_star, fill = factor(eps2_target)),
           position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  # Base bar at alpha = 0 (neutral grey)
  geom_col(data = base_bar,
           aes(x = alpha, y = Q_star),
           fill = "grey50",
           width = 0.8) +
  # Reference line
  geom_hline(yintercept = 694444, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  # Base case triangle on top of the base bar (no dodging)
  geom_point(data = base_case,
             aes(x = factor(0, levels = alpha_levels), y = Q_star),
             color = "blue", size = 3, shape = 17) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "C", end = 0.85) +
  labs(title = "Novo Nordisk Equilibrium Quantity: Generic Paradox",
       x = "Alpha (Generic Drug Market Share)",
       y = "Equilibrium Quantity (Q*)",
       fill = "Assumed Elasticity") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")


ggsave("risingprices.png", plot = Plot3,
       width = 8, height = 6, units = "in",
       dpi = 600)   # 300 dpi = print quality

ggsave("fallingquantities.png", plot = Plot4,
       width = 8, height = 6, units = "in",
       dpi = 600)   # 300 dpi = print quality
```







## Competitive Fringe Scenario Analysis 

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# --- Parameters from your base setup ---
Qos  <- 694444
Pos  <- 300
MCQo <- 6.5

# Recover original a, b from your system
A <- matrix(c(1, -Qos,
              1, -2*Qos), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
B <- c(Pos, MCQo)
sol <- solve(A, B)
a <- sol[1]; b <- sol[2]

# --- Scenario grids ---
ff_grid  <- seq(5.5, 7.5, by = 0.5)
vv_grid  <- c(0.1, 0.01, 0.001, 0.0001, 0.00001, 0.000001)
n_grid   <- 1:20
g2_grid  <- c(0.05, 0.10, 0.15)
years2   <- 8   # fixed horizon

scenarios <- expand.grid(
  ff = ff_grid,
  vv = vv_grid,
  n = n_grid,
  g2 = g2_grid,
  KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# --- Solver function for competitive fringe model ---
solve_fringe <- function(ff, vv, n, g2, years2, a, b, MCQo) {
  # Demand intercept adjusted for growth
  m <- (a * (1 + g2)^years2 / b + n * ff / vv) / (1/b + n/vv)
  k <- 1 / (1/b + n/vv)

  # Dominant firm quantity
  QNNs <- (m - MCQo) / (2 * k)

  # Equilibrium price
  Po_QNN <- function(QNN) {
    numerator   <- a*(1 + g2)^years2 / b + n*ff / vv - QNN
    denominator <- 1/b + n/vv
    numerator / denominator
  }
  Pos_2 <- Po_QNN(QNNs)

  # Fringe supply (guardrail: nonnegative)
  Sf_total <- max(n * ((Pos_2 - ff) / vv), 0)
  Sf_per_firm <- ifelse(n > 0, Sf_total / n, 0)

  # Total market supply
  Q_total <- QNNs + Sf_total

  data.frame(
    ff = ff,
    vv = vv,
    n = n,
    g2 = g2,
    years2 = years2,
    QNNs = QNNs,
    Pos_2 = Pos_2,
    Sf_total = Sf_total,
    Sf_per_firm = Sf_per_firm,
    Q_total = Q_total
  )
}

# --- Evaluate all scenarios ---
results_fringe <- scenarios %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  do({
    with(., solve_fringe(ff, vv, n, g2, years2, a, b, MCQo))
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

# --- Quick overview ---
dplyr::glimpse(results_fringe)

# Example: head of results
print(head(results_fringe, 1000))
```



### Varying n
```{r}
library(dplyr)

# --- Fixed parameters ---
ff     <- 6.5
vv     <- 0.001
g2     <- 0.1
years2 <- 8
MCQo   <- 6.5

# Recover original a, b from your system
Qos  <- 694444
Pos  <- 300
A <- matrix(c(1, -Qos,
              1, -2*Qos), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
B <- c(Pos, MCQo)
sol <- solve(A, B)
a <- sol[1]; b <- sol[2]

# --- Solver function ---
solve_fringe <- function(n, ff, vv, g2, years2, a, b, MCQo) {
  m <- (a * (1 + g2)^years2 / b + n * ff / vv) / (1/b + n/vv)
  k <- 1 / (1/b + n/vv)

  QNNs <- (m - MCQo) / (2 * k)

  Po_QNN <- function(QNN) {
    numerator   <- a*(1 + g2)^years2 / b + n*ff / vv - QNN
    denominator <- 1/b + n/vv
    numerator / denominator
  }
  Pos_2 <- Po_QNN(QNNs)

  Sf_total <- max(n * ((Pos_2 - ff) / vv), 0)
  Sf_per_firm <- ifelse(n > 0, Sf_total / n, 0)
  Q_total <- QNNs + Sf_total

  data.frame(
    n = n,
    QNNs = QNNs,
    Pos_2 = Pos_2,
    Sf_total = Sf_total,
    Sf_per_firm = Sf_per_firm,
    Q_total = Q_total
  )
}

# --- Build simplified matrix ---
n_grid <- 2:20

results_simple <- lapply(n_grid, function(n) {
  solve_fringe(n, ff, vv, g2, years2, a, b, MCQo)
}) %>% bind_rows()

# --- Quick look ---
print(results_simple)
```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

ymin <- floor(min(results_simple$Pos_2)) - 2
ymax <- ceiling(max(results_simple$Pos_2)) + 2

ggplot(results_simple, aes(x = n, y = Pos_2)) +
  geom_line(color = "red", size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(color = "red", size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 300, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 10)) +   # neat ticks, auto range
  labs(title = "Equilibrium Price vs. Number of Fringe Firms",
       subtitle = "Red line = competitive fringe model; dashed line = original monopoly price",
       x = "Number of Fringe Firms (n)",
       y = "Equilibrium Price") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

# --- Quantities vs. number of fringe firms ---
results_long <- results_simple %>%
  select(n, QNNs, Sf_total, Q_total) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(QNNs, Sf_total, Q_total),
                      names_to = "Quantity_Type", values_to = "Quantity")

ggplot(results_long, aes(x = n, y = Quantity, color = Quantity_Type)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("QNNs" = "red",
                                "Sf_total" = "blue",
                                "Q_total" = "darkgreen"),
                     labels = c("Total Market Output",
                                "Novo Nordisk Output",
                                "Total Generics Output")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(title = "Output vs. Number of Fringe Firms",
       subtitle = "Red = dominant firm, Blue = fringe, Green = total market",
       x = "Number of Fringe Firms (n)",
       y = "Quantity",
       color = "Output Type") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```
